name: Yabuno Chiyuru
source:
Chiyuru is also in second year and is in the Health committee, she is quite naive and straight-speaking – essentially a genki type character who lives by her own rhythm. She is pretty smart and very mischievous and likes making perverse jokes. She loves to read romantic stories (with ecchi elements) and is a romanticist even though she has no experience whatsoever with real love. Since she doesn’t act very girly, Hitori has never really considered her as a “girl” or a romantic interest… Will she manage to find her Prince Charming?

[From [url=http://liemyx.wordpress.com/2011/06/12/preview-yomehapi-you-make-happy/]Liemyx's blog[/url]]
